verdict.rationale: LangGraph's core is a code/graph API (nodes, edges, streaming, checkpointers, interrupts) so most functionality is inherently API-first, and docs show programmatic control over persistence, streaming, and human-in-the-loop. However, there's no evidence of a documented OpenAPI/REST spec for the Agent Server (probe for openapi.json returned all 404s), and no direct comparison showing API/UI (e.g. LangGraph Studio) feature parity, leaving open questions about whether Studio-only features are accessible via API.
